name: Rithwic Festival Grounds
title: 10.4N, 53.5E - Rithwic Festival Grounds
summary: One of the Festival Grounds, just west of Rithwic (Darkness Ascendant): two shopkeepers in tents, two chessboards, a running track and target drudges. In the kit (z 24): two striped octagon tents with flags, eleven red pennant poles, a running track of wooden archways lit by candles and candelabras, a 20 x 20 m dance canvas, two chessboards on pads, benches and target drudges; the Leafdawning Festival Stone (batch 1) on the hill 160 m east.

landmarks.name: Octagon tents (0x01000F06)
landmarks.note: Two, at y 26964 and 26988, flags on top.

site.name: Rithwic Festival Grounds
site.notes: Gazetteer has only a map @tele for the grounds (the nearest @teleloc is the Leafdawning Festival Stone, 163 m east, which belongs to POI batch 1); derived @teleloc on open grass 59 m south of the grounds.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 48 m above the festival grounds and turn slowly: the two striped octagon tents, the red pennants, the candle-lit running-track arches, the dance canvas and the chessboards laid out like a board game in the evening light; hold height, no drift.
